standard_prerequisites.name: There is a functorial construction of tensoring with limits, giving exact functors of triangulated categories Delta: D(A) -> D(N,A), tensor, and Rlim
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the construction whose output applied to the input triangle yields the asserted canonical triangle.

core_obligations: The system of objects E_n, D_n, F_n comes from applying Delta to E, D, F (proof line 23931). Tensoring the distinguished triangle E -> D -> F -> E[1] with K using the construction of the remark produces a distinguished triangle of systems in D(N,A) (proof lines 23931-23933), because tensoring is an exact functor of triangulated categories (proof lines 23934-23935). Applying Rlim, again exact, yields the distinguished triangle Rlim(K tensor E_n) -> Rlim(K tensor D_n) -> Rlim(K tensor F_n) -> Rlim(K tensor E_n)[1] in D(A), with canonical maps as asserted (proof lines 23935-23936).
proof_roadmap: Apply the functorial tensoring construction of the remark to the input triangle (proof lines 23931-23933).
Conclude by exactness of tensor and Rlim as functors of triangulated categories (proof lines 23934-23936).
